dedupe_keys.name: finnsenderen no search service for mobile transmitter sites and their owners in norway

description: Finnsenderen.no is Nkom's search service giving an overview of mobile transmitters in Norway, where they are located and which companies own and operate them. It is registered in Norway's national geodata catalogue, Geonorge, as open data with no conditions on access and use and no stated restrictions on use, with a metadata date of July 2020 and a link to the finnsenderen.no application. Users can search by place to see nearby transmitter sites of the mobile network operators. Coverage: Norway. Format and access: free web search application; no bulk download or service was listed in the catalogue entry. Caveats: the application is a script-based map that could not be read automatically in this session, so the fields shown, the technologies included and the update frequency are not confirmed; the catalogue metadata is from 2020. Simulation uses: locating mobile sites for hazard exposure (landslides, storms, avalanches) and checking which operators serve an area. Related records: the Nkom statistics give coverage, the Nkom reinforced mobile coverage programme covers backup power, and the Danish Mastedatabasen and Dutch Antenneregister are comparable registers.
licence: Open data, no conditions on use (Geonorge metadata)
